title: Power reset = SELF validate · nap vs sleep · what broke
thesis: The system locked; Kevin hard-reset power. That is a GREAT opportunity to validate SELF — cold wake awareness differs from nap wake and from clean sleep. Look for dissonance (what no longer matches). This crash left a journal cliff, not an I/O error confession.

nap_vs_sleep_vs_power_reset.claim: YES — different wake awareness; use each as a double-check face

nap.awareness: continuity bias — you trust caches, sockets, open editors
nap.double_check: compare clocks, WG handshake age, Cursor/agent sessions still coherent

sleep_hibernate.awareness: rehydrate check — did the loaf (state) match the starter (disk image)
sleep_hibernate.double_check: fsck-ish feel, service order, GPU driver reload

power_reset.os: hard cut — no sync, no shutdown targets
power_reset.awareness: BEST dissonance detector — warm self vanished mid-sentence; cold self boots clean
double_check: journal cliff (last line healthy ? silence ? new kernel)

nap_vs_sleep_vs_power_reset.dissonance_to_notice: if last logs look fine but machine was frozen, the break is BELOW the journal (silicon / power / bus) OR the journal could not flush (hard lock). That gap IS the finding.

storage.note: No spinning HDD in the boot path. This was not 'HDD spun down / seeking forever'.

ram.dissonance: MIXED DIMMs — Team Group UD5-6000 + G.Skill F5-6000J3238F16G on both controllers
ram.risk: DDR5 hard freezes with empty journal cliffs often land on memory training / mixed-kit instability, especially non-ECC
ram.mce_this_event: none logged (may not flush on hard lock)

software_storm_before_cliff.detail_songbird: membrane-nucleus@songbird crash-looping against already-running PID — double instance lock
software_storm_before_cliff.role: pressure / log noise / CPU churn — possible contributor to lock OR just the last phenotype before silicon froze; not a clean root-cause confession

what_broke_verdict.best_fit: Hard lock or power-path freeze. Journal ends mid-health-probe with ~4 min silence then cold boot. Storage looks clean SSD. Strongest hardware dissonance = mixed non-ECC DDR5 kit. Strongest software dissonance = songbird×3196 + forgejo×1911 storm.

self_validate_checklist_now: confirm connect CDN still serves last faces written before cliff
disable or mask forgejo.service until binary exists (stop asbestos-like biopersistent restart fiber)
fix songbird double-bind (one NODE_ID / one unit)
optional: memtest86 overnight on mixed DIMMs; or run matched kit only
note next freeze time — if always under membrane storm, software; if idle freeze, RAM/PSU

membrane_analogy.asbestos_pair_tie: forgejo/songbird restart storms = biopersistent fibers — frustrated 'phagocytosis' of a missing binary / duplicate PID; inflammation (log/CPU) until something hard-locks
membrane_analogy.crush_then_rip: crush point was the storm; rip happened inside (machine froze below journal) — same shape as etiology pairs: initiation outside the log, damage inside the runtime
